failure_summary.description: Agents returned a salient related entity or detail instead of the target indicated by the clue's grammatical relation.
Bare quote and name-list prompts were treated as descriptions rather than clues to the associated work or show.
Agents gave an incomplete title or expanded a short answer despite the context supporting the expected answer form.

patch.reasoning: The skill already instructs agents to identify the requested type and reject related-but-wrong candidates, so repeating generic slot-parsing advice would not address the failures where that rule was ignored. A narrower answer-form rule addresses the two cases where the reasoning identified the target but the final answer's span was wrong.

edits.content:
## Preserve Direct Answer Forms
When context explicitly keys an answer or gives the canonical name or title of the identified target, preserve that form in the final answer. Do not expand a keyed short answer with extra name components, or reduce a multiword proper title to only one modifier.
